data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Nawash' which means intelligent, Nawshin refers to a friend of the intelligent ones. The name Nawshin carries the meaning “Friend of the Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawshin usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who seeks wisdom and knowledge in the Divine presence.
data.etymology: Nawshin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawshin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
